source.label: Probability

metricDefinitions.label: Probability
metricDefinitions.definition: Central interval endpoints q05/q95 have nominal 90% coverage and a 5% upper-tail reference. Asymmetric endpoints q075/q975 allocate 7.5% below and 2.5% above, also nominal 90%. Fixed split/CQR intervals are calibrated bounds, not a fully calibrated conditional CDF. All references are targets, not established guarantees.
